item.title: ICE bids to reopen Marana prison as immigration detention facility, sparking lawmaker outcry
item.description: ICE is moving toward reopening a shuttered Marana prison under a planned two-year, sole-source agreement with Management & Training Corp., according to a federal contract notice.
